title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 1.00 (quiet) at 04:00 UTC on 21 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 21 日 04:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 1.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp = 1.00 (label 1Z) at 04:00 UTC. The 04:00 hour is now complete (60 samples through 04:59; end-of-hour 1.00/1Z). 05:00 UTC is a trailing incomplete hour (only 6 samples to 05:05), so it is not used. Last-180 maximum 1.67 first at 02:34 UTC on 21 September (label 2M; last-180 window from 02:06 UTC). Published-window maximum 1.67. Window start 23:08 UTC on 20 September (358 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0.
summary.zh: 最新可靠整點估計 Kp = 1.00（標籤 1Z；04:00 UTC）。04:00 時段已收滿 60 筆（至 04:59，時段末 1.00／1Z）。05:00 UTC 為未收滿時段（至 05:05 僅 6 筆），故不採用。近 180 筆最大 1.67（最先見於 2026-09-21 02:34 UTC；標籤 2M；近 180 筆窗自 02:06 UTC 起）；公開窗最大 1.67。窗起點 2026-09-20 23:08 UTC（358 筆）。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of a completed hour that is not a trailing incomplete placeholder (04:00 UTC). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off. Hour-start 04:00 UTC is 1.00/1Z; the trailing 05:00 hour is incomplete and unused.

title.en: A magnitude 4.7 earthquake occurred 156 km NNW of Hicks Bay, New Zealand on 21 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 21 日，紐西蘭 Hicks Bay 北北西約 156 公里發生規模 4.7 地震。

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mb 4.7, depth about 213 km. Current day-feed maximum is mww 6.4 (us7000tiqc, Papua New Guinea).
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mb 4.7，深度約 213 公里。本輪新上架。一日饋送目前最大為 mww 6.4（us7000tiqc，巴布亞紐幾內亞）。

data.place: 156 km NNW of Hicks Bay, New Zealand

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
evidence.limitations: Magnitudes and locations can be revised by USGS. The day feed only retains recent M4.5+ events.
